welcome.title: Finger play
welcome.text: Steps without windows come first: do what each one says with your fingers while the cameras record your hands. Then windows will appear in front of you: they don't move or click.|Press the button on the right side of the headset to start each step. Pressed while recording, it pauses.

done.title: All done
done.text: Thank you! This recording session will close. Continue in the application.|Review your recordings in the Hand recorder window.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.text: What was recorded so far is saved. Review it in the Hand recorder window.

sections.title: Hand size
sections.intro: First, your hand size: both hands up about 40 cm out, still.

prompts.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Palms toward you

switch.text: Both hands about 40 cm out, still|Backs toward you

sections.title: Finger play
sections.intro: Anything with your fingers, as long as they each do something different. The steps give ideas: there's no wrong way, so make it odd. Mostly palm toward you, near and far.

prompts.text: Right hand, palm toward you, about 40 cm out. Play an invisible piano in the air:|each finger pressing on its own, fast and slow.

switch.text: Keep playing, the hand close now:|about a forearm's length from your eyes.

prompts.text: Left hand, palm toward you, about 40 cm out. Play an invisible piano in the air:|each finger pressing on its own, fast and slow.

switch.text: Keep playing, the hand close now:|about a forearm's length from your eyes.

prompts.text: Palm toward you. Count on your fingers in a strange order, raising and dropping them one at a time,|skipping around. Then two at a time that aren't next to each other.
Palm toward you. Ripple your fingers in a wave, little finger to index and back,|then flick each finger out from under the thumb.
Palm toward you. Make shapes, a new one every second or two: rock horns, a finger gun,|the OK sign, crossed fingers, a claw, or anything else.
Keep the fingers moving while you slowly turn the hand: palm toward you,|on its side, back toward you, and round again.
Both hands, palms toward you, each doing its own thing:|one playing piano while the other counts, or anything else.
Palm toward you, fingers moving the whole time: start at arm's length,|bring the hand all the way in to a forearm's length from your eyes and back out.

sections.title: Piano keys
sections.intro: A row of keys low in front of you, like a piano. Rest your fingers over them and press the lit key with the finger above it. Nothing happens when you do: the cameras record your hand.

prompts.text: Right hand over the keys. Press the lit key with the finger above it,|the others staying up.

says.poke: Press it with the finger above it

prompts.text: Left hand over the keys. Press the lit key with the finger above it,|the others staying up.

says.poke: Press it with the finger above it

prompts.text: Both hands over a longer row. Each lit key says L or R:|press it with a finger of that hand.

says.poke: Press it with a finger of that hand
